globalProperty.description: The concept UUID for the "Next Contact Date" (e.g., CIEL 5096) observation. When an observation is created with this concept, a corresponding appointment will be scheduled automatically.
The UUID of the default Appointment Service to assign to auto-generated appointments. If left blank, the appointment will be created without a specific service.

SMTP server hostname for sending password reset emails. Normally set from LIBERIAEMR_SMTP_HOST in the deployment environment; this property is the fallback for a developer changing it on a live box. Use 'localhost' for a local relay, or an external provider (e.g., smtp.sendgrid.net, email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com).
SMTP username. Normally set from LIBERIAEMR_SMTP_USER. Leave empty for local open relays.

SMTP password. DEVELOPMENT FALLBACK ONLY, and never seeded from versioned content: in a deployment this comes from LIBERIAEMR_SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE (a path read verbatim) or LIBERIAEMR_SMTP_PASSWORD. Leave empty for local open relays.
The "From" email address used in password reset emails. Normally set from LIBERIAEMR_SMTP_FROM.

Base URL of the frontend SPA used to construct password reset links in emails. Normally set from LIBERIAEMR_FRONTEND_URL. A trailing slash is stripped. Examples: http://localhost:8080/openmrs/spa, https://liberiaemr.org/openmrs/spa
Number of hours a password reset token remains valid before expiring.

The patient identifier type whose exact match links two records to one person, once sex and date of birth agree (ADR 0005). Set by the national content package to the Liberia National ID; empty mints CPIs without linking.
How far apart two documented dates of birth may be and still agree for the National ID rule. When either date is estimated only the year is compared.
How many newly received patients the identity task assigns a CPI on each run.
How often the identity task runs, in seconds (at least 10). A change takes effect without a restart.
[Future] Base URL for the SMS gateway API used for MFA OTP delivery.
[Future] API key for the configured SMS gateway provider.
